uncertainties.detail: Primary slot tables are reproduced and integrity-checked. Secondary pages were sampled/retrieved, but every row has not been independently compared with both sites. Unavailable/maintenance responses are recorded per URL; do not equate retrieval with verification.
Serebii omits some Headbutt levels/rates. Use primary ten-/six-slot rules and Bulbapedia tree groups; tree eligibility still depends on the Trainer ID.

Primary ordinary and Clefairy scene banks differ. Both are explicitly labelled and separated; secondary guides do not consistently distinguish these banks. No real-game water-table validation is claimed.
Presence depends on phone registration and rematch/event scheduling. Requirements are retained without assuming a saved calendar state.
Requires an eligible historical Enigma Stone event. It is not treated as normally unlocked or available through a current distribution.
